rules: One phase at a time; no automatic progression.
A task request must identify exact authorized task IDs.
Production release must be included in the approved task/phase.
Consequential architecture choices require evidence-backed recommendation and approval.
Silence, prior interest or broad project intent is not approval.
While a phase is authorized, only task IDs listed in its authorized_tasks may be started; the validator enforces this.
